absent: Criteria used by the splittable checker and the full set of split type modes beyond uniform and non uniform.
Internals of unmapping, remapping, freezing and unmapped division helpers and their lock and reference contracts.
Layout of folio, page, anon area, address space, shmem inode and superblock structures and their flag definitions.
Semantics of mapping minimum order, file reclaim mask handling, xarray cursor operations and shmem end adjustment.
Reference counting rules for expected versus observed folio references and device private handling.
Meaning of PMD order detection, multi size order statistics and virtual machine event counters.
Shrinker framework contracts, list LRU operations, partially mapped and mlocked folio semantics and reclaim accounting.
Threshold configuration for underuse detection, zero page identity and page identity comparison.
Page table level sizes, huge leaf detection, zero entry handling and walk termination pairing.
Normal page discrimination for PUD and other levels and special versus present entry handling.
Zone iteration, online page lookup, tail page detection, folio zone attribution and transparent huge classification.
Task lookup, address space acquisition, area lookup and area suitability predicates for DAX, special huge, IO and hugetlb.
File open by name, filemap folio lookup, index versus offset handling and file close contracts.
Debug filesystem creation parameters, file operation table layout and user copy and string parsing helpers.
Memory cgroup charging for folio operations and active cgroup switching rules.
Interrupt disable and enable pairing requirements around xarray and spin locking.

findings.text: Two public helpers expose large folio division with different addressing. One derives its folio from a page and always splits uniformly from the folio start while keeping the caller page position locked. The other accepts an explicit folio and an arbitrary intra folio division point and requests a non uniform division while keeping the folio start locked. Both forward to a shared internal divider together with a caller supplied list for results.

A query reports the smallest order to which a folio may currently be divided. Anonymous folios allow division down to order zero. File folios without an attached mapping also report zero with the understanding that a later division attempt will fail as busy. Otherwise the bound comes from the owning mapping minimum.

Two accounting helpers maintain shmem inode usage. One recomputes allocation after cache changes from caller supplied allocation and swap deltas combined with current cache occupancy and releases surplus quota outside the inode lock while reporting whether swapping started. The other forces a recomputation without deltas to reflect removals performed elsewhere.

A walker locates the folio backing a virtual address inside a known area. It requires the address space lock held by the caller, descends through successive table levels with per level locking, distinguishes absent versus table versus leaf entries including huge leaves, optionally recognizes zero pages, and on success returns the owning folio while leaving the leaf lock held and a cursor describing level and position.

A helper resolves the ordinary page for a PUD leaf by forwarding architecture independent discriminators such as frame number, special flag and raw entry bytes together with a PUD level tag to a shared normal page discriminator.

Division requires a locked large folio, a target order strictly below the current order, and both the division point and the lock retention point located inside the same folio. It also requires a splittable verdict from a dedicated checker, and for file backed folios a target at or above the mapping minimum plus a successful reclaimability probe. Failures report invalid argument, while transient unsuitability reports busy or again.

Anonymous and file backed divisions diverge in serialization and cache handling. Anonymous handling takes a temporary reference on the anon area then its write lock to exclude parallel division or merging and uses no address space. File handling validates against mapping minima, probes reclaimability under the file reclaim mask, points an xarray cursor at the mapping with uniform order preparation and preallocation, holds the interval tree for reading, and snapshots a page aligned end from inode size with a shmem specific end adjustment to allow later trimming beyond end of file.

Successful division unmaps the whole range including splitting of middle level entries, verifies reference stability and continued cache presence under interrupt exclusion and xarray locking, then performs the unmapped division with optional end trimming and shmem dropping. Afterwards it releases shmem charge, remaps the range with a shared zero optimization limited to anonymous non device memory, drops interval serialization while the inode remains pinned, keeps locked only the result containing the requested retention page, unlocks and puts other results with deferred tail freeing, and records success or failure counters for PMD sized and for other multi size orders.

Callers must hold the folio lock on entry. Anonymous serialization uses a referenced anon area held for writing across unmap and division. File serialization uses interval read lock plus xarray lock taken with interrupts disabled around cache verification and unmapped division. A temporary switch of the active memory cgroup covers xarray node charging and is restored afterwards with reference release and cursor destruction. Post division cleanup releases anon write lock and reference or interval read lock exactly once depending on path.

Shmem inode state keeps allocated and swapped counters protected by an inode spinlock. Surplus is derived from allocated less swapped less current cache occupancy, with an upward adjustment when the call raises swapped to compensate for ordering against cache removal. Positive surplus reduces the allocated counter under lock then releases quota and block counts outside the lock where sleeping is allowed, including conditional reversal of memory reservation for no reserve inodes based on a page aligned size to page count conversion.
The debug split control accepts at most 255 bytes of user input per write, with explicit truncation and termination handling.
Memory accounting converts a byte length to a page count by first rounding up to page granularity then shifting by page order.

Deferred division uses a least recently used queue scanned by a shrinker. Counting reports queue occupancy or an empty marker. Isolation moves entries with a live reference to a private dispose list and clears partially mapped marking with statistic adjustment for entries lost to concurrent freeing. Scanning detaches each entry, skips locked memory and sufficiently utilized entries unless partially mapped, attempts locked division while handling contention by requeue under read copy update protection with node and cgroup affinity, and signals stop only when nothing was isolated and nothing divided.

Underuse detection is disabled when the allowed count of empty entries is set to one less than the PMD fanout, and never triggers for folios containing poisoned subpages. Otherwise it tallies zero filled subpages by comparison against the shared zero page against a configured maximum, with early acceptance once the zero tally passes the maximum and early rejection once the filled tally proves the folio cannot be underused.

Whole system division iterates all managed zones by frame number, skipping offline frames, tail pages, non large or hugetlb or non reclaimable queue folios, cross zone aliases and unstable folio identities, then attempts locked division advancing by the folio footprint. Per process division masks its range to page bounds, resolves the target address space, skips unsuitable areas covering device, special huge, input output and hugetlb types, walks each page to its folio, requires transparent huge type, clamps the target order against mapping minima for file memory, enforces reference and mapping stability, and chooses whole folio ordered division versus offset directed division based on whether the supplied intra folio offset lies inside the folio.

A write only debug entry demultiplexes split requests under a single interruptible mutex. Inputs beginning with a slash name a file path plus page index bounds with optional order and intra folio offset for file backed division. Other inputs carry process identifier plus virtual bounds with optional order and offset, where an identifier of one with no range triggers whole system division. Parsing failures and user copy failures report invalid or fault status, and successful handling reports the consumed input length.

File backed division opens the named file read only, clamps its target order against the mapping minimum, then steps through the requested index interval advancing by one for misses and by the observed folio footprint for large candidates. It ignores non large and already small enough folios, requires a nonblocking folio lock and continued attachment to the same mapping, and selects whole ordered division versus offset directed division according to intra folio offset validity before closing the file.

The walker asserts address space protection and brackets traversal with area table begin and end markers while rejecting out of range addresses with warnings. It descends from global through fourth and upper levels with bad entry clearing, then handles upper and middle huge capable levels by rechecking under the corresponding table lock and distinguishing empty, nested table and leaf cases, falling through to a mapped locked last level entry when no huge leaf matched. Leaf handling records entry size and level with snapshots of pointers and values, resolves ordinary pages while optionally accepting huge and base zero pages, and on any miss releases the leaf lock and table pin before returning absence.

On success the walker fills a cursor with the table level, snapshots of the leaf entry and its pointer, the held leaf lock, and the precise subpage corresponding to the address offset inside the leaf size, with a null page marker used for the zero page acceptance case. The returned folio corresponds to the base page of that position rather than the folio start. Callers must pair success with a matching walk termination that releases the held lock and pin.

Shmem counter updates hold an inode spinlock only for counter arithmetic and defer quota release that may sleep until after unlock. Deferred queue additions and removals use interrupt safe list primitives with read copy update protection for requeue. Per process splitting holds address space read lock across the whole range scan with per folio try locking and address space reference held. Table walking holds the appropriate table lock on the successful path and releases it on miss paths, with area level begin and end bracketing. Debug writes serialize on a dedicated mutex interruptibly.

Division must tolerate anon area disappearance, file truncation and eviction between checks, size changes under folio lock, reference count drift from concurrent mapping, and cache replacement before freezing, reported as busy or again for retry. Splitting beyond end of file can drop tails from cache so retention must rely on the head folio rather than a possibly dropped tail. Deferred isolation must read folio state before removal because unqueued folios may free concurrently. System and pid scanners must revalidate folio identity, zone and mapping after acquiring references or locks and must reschedule cooperatively during long scans.

Large folio division moves through validation, path specific preparation, reference stability gating, unmapping, interrupt excluded cache verified frozen division, charge adjustment and remapping, then selective result unlocking and serialization release, with early exits preserving caller lock and memcg state and late exits never touching inode or mapping after pin release.

Two shrinker callbacks expose deferred division to reclaim. One reports reclaimable queue depth for pressure accounting. The other performs bounded reclamation by isolating candidates and attempting division, returning divided count or a stop signal when idle.
